### Aristotle on friendship

Aristotle (384–322 BCE) approaches friendship within Peripatetic. Aristotle pursued demonstrative science grounded in observation, definition, and causal explanation. His Organon developed syllogistic logic and standards of proof that structured Western reasoning for two millennia. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets friendship most directly—useful for searches such as “aristotle quotes on friendship.”
